intro: At the Eastvale Logging Camp stables, Katie Hunter tends horses for Stormwind and trusted Alliance champions. She works with Randal Hunter to keep travelers and soldiers mounted for the kingdom’s roads.

p: Katie Hunter tends the horses at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. While lumberjacks cut timber for Stormwind’s reconstruction, she raises dependable pintos, mares, and swift steeds for riders. Her horses carry people along the kingdom’s roads and the dangerous routes of southern Azeroth.
